finding: The ontology-defined core GWAS set is phenotypically heterogeneous
value: 104 core accessions include susceptibility, severity/progression, chronic bronchitis, pulmonary artery enlargement, smoking-stratified/joint models, broad ICD/PheCode, gene/CNV tests, and a machine-learning spirogram liability score
planning_method: Read-only inspection and manual design classification
interpretation: Primary COPD ontology mapping is not sufficient phenotype adjudication.

finding: Machine-learning spirogram liability materially drives the V1 universe
value: GCST90244098 contributes 356 of 660 GWS tags; 337 are exclusive; it links to 177 of 337 candidates and is the sole linked study accession for 124 of 337
interpretation: A strict susceptibility sensitivity analysis could materially change candidate support.

finding: The repository does not contain an auditable manual phenotype-adjudication artifact
value: No accession-level adjudication rules/register found beyond ontology/text classification, although the manuscript refers to manual phenotype review
interpretation: Phenotype claims need a V2 study register; structural validation did not test semantic coherence.

finding: Most final candidates cannot inherit COPD-risk direction from V1
value: 316 of 337 are proxy-only; V1 stores unsigned r-squared; 24 of 660 tags have more than one reported allele
interpretation: Risk-allele-to-model gain/loss requires study-specific full-statistic harmonization; REF/ALT and r-squared are insufficient.

finding: V1 negative controls are usually not accessible in the disease donor
value: 44,639 of 362,704 enhancer controls (12.31%) and 9,490 of 61,168 silencer controls (15.51%) overlap the donor ATAC union, while every positive is donor-ATAC-overlapping by definition
interpretation: Held-out AUC may partly reflect donor accessibility/source discrimination; a same-donor accessible-control sensitivity model is higher priority than indiscriminate context expansion.

finding: V1 allele scoring is not reverse-complement invariant by construction
value: No reverse-complement augmentation or forward/reverse averaging is implemented
interpretation: A cheap frozen-model forward-versus-reverse-complement concordance test is required before new training.

finding: Model uncertainty across seeds and chromosome splits was not measured
value: One deterministic seed (20261001) and one fixed chromosome split (train chr1-6,10-22,X,Y; validation chr7; test chr8-9)
interpretation: Reproducibility of one run is strong; robustness of predictions to initialization/control sampling/split remains unknown.

finding: The allelic cutoff is relative to the ascertained COPD candidate universe
value: Absolute REF-ALT difference at the 95th percentile within SNV or indel class, plus a phase-II test-set-derived 5% control-FPR region threshold
interpretation: The 337 are extreme within the V1 candidate set, not an FDR-controlled or posterior-causal set.

finding: Training unions can pair accessibility and histone peaks across different lobes
value: All-lobe ATAC and all-lobe histone files are unioned before positive construction; Section 3 refined annotation instead enforces same-lobe overlap
interpretation: A same-lobe label sensitivity check is warranted; cross-lobe combinations may broaden labels.

finding: The word silencer exceeds the direct assay evidence
value: Silencer positives are accessible regions overlapping H3K27me3; no functional silencer assay defines the training labels
interpretation: V2 should call this an accessible H3K27me3-associated/repressed-sequence model while preserving V1 result names.

finding: FAM13A rs2013701 is recovered but not highly ranked
value: Exact candidate 4:88963935:G:T is enhancer-positive at frozen rank 210; enhancer region score 0.9101 and SNV delta percentile 95.80; it is not silencer-positive
interpretation: The V1 rank does not encode external literature confidence; recovery supports some sensitivity but one example cannot establish calibration.

finding: A strong COPD splice mechanism is outside the enhancer/silencer model scope
value: rs34712979 is an exact GWS NPNT splice-region tag; V1 enhancer scores 0.2224/0.2024 (delta -0.0200) and silencer scores 0.0776/0.0698 (delta -0.00783), below frozen region and delta cutoffs
planning_method: Exact read-only row inspection plus primary-paper verification
interpretation: Non-recovery is expected for a splice mechanism and argues for mechanism-stratified benchmarking, not threshold relaxation.

finding: V1 target-gene evidence is broad and provisional
value: 4,779 candidate-gene-method rows and 1,635 gene labels for 337 candidates; every candidate receives nearest-TSS hypotheses; no matched-donor contact map
interpretation: The 144-of-185 GTEx-to-broad-target concordance is not a calibrated target-validation rate.

finding: Local GTEx evidence cannot support colocalization
value: The local GTEx v10 Lung archive contains significant pairs/eGenes; V1 found 185 of 337 exact candidates and explicitly did not perform colocalization
interpretation: Full regional GWAS and QTL statistics are mandatory for a new colocalization claim.

finding: V1 workflow validation establishes integrity, not biological truth
interpretation: Hashes, rectangularity, IDs, counts, figures, and citation checks do not test phenotype validity, model transportability, or causal interpretation.

finding: Upstream phase-I training provenance is not available in the local record
value: The 565-MB frozen phase-I model has local architecture, features, weights, and a recorded SHA-256, but no training-dataset or chromosome-exposure manifest
interpretation: Chromosome holdout is established for phase-II labels only; end-to-end representation exposure remains unavailable unless upstream provenance is recovered.

finding: V1 threshold operating-point performance is not an untouched-test estimate
value: Nominal 1/3/5/10% FPR score thresholds are selected from the chr8-9 phase-II test ROC and then evaluated on the same set; Brier/ECE use an approximately 1:2 sampled positive:control mixture derived from the control-sampling design
interpretation: ROC/PR AUC remains a phase-II held-out discrimination measure; V2 must calibrate thresholds outside the untouched test set and compare calibration only at fixed or adjusted prevalence.
